sections.text_helper: Section 13.1 "Interconnect matrix introduction" in chapter 13 (Peripherals interconnect matrix), RM0522 Rev 1, page 371.
sections.section_content:
Several peripherals have direct connections between them, enabling autonomous
communication and/or synchronization: this approach saves CPU resources and power
supply consumption. In addition, these hardware connections remove software latency and
help the design of a predictable system.
Depending on peripherals, these interconnections can operate in Run, Sleep, and Stop
modes.
